This '''EG-6 power droid'''<ref name="BtM" /> was found by [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and held inside a [[Digger crawler|sandcrawler]] where it encountered [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] just prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SW4" />

==History==
The droid's memory was enhanced beyond that of a standard power droid and it became more useful as a diagnostics system analyzer than an energizer. It spent most of its existence on a Tatooine [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farm]] and became adept at analyzing farm and agricultural equipment.<ref name="GG1" />

Some time prior to the Battle of Yavin, the droid's farm was raided by [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] who killed its owners. The power droid was then salvaged by Jawas and brought on board their sandcrawler, where it eventually encountered C-3PO and R2-D2. The droid's enhanced programming led it to be friendly and able to give technical advice. Having had its identification numbers removed, the droid had no name but was content to know he was more advanced than his peers.<ref name="GG1" />

==Behind the scenes==
This droid first appeared briefly inside the Jawa's sandcrawler in {{Film|IV}}.<ref name="SW4" /> [[Kenner Products|Kenner]] released a "Power Droid" action figure in [[1978]] with this droid's photo on the packaging,<ref name="Kenner">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars (Kenner toy line)|pack=Power Droid|link=VINtPowerdroid.asp}}</ref> but its design and coloring more closely resemble [[Unidentified EG-6 power droid (Lars homestead)|another droid]] seen in the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]] in the film.<ref name="SW4" /> The dark lighting in the movie scene makes it difficult to determine the droid's actual color; a ''[[Classic Star Wars: A New Hope (flap book)|Classic Star Wars]]'' children's book and one Hasbro action figure gave the droid a beige color<ref name="Classic SW">[[Classic Star Wars: A New Hope (flap book)|''Classic Star Wars: A New Hope'' flap book]]</ref><ref name="Droid Set">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Vintage Collection|packtype=Special Action Figure Set|pack=Droid Set|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/Power_Droid_Set_Special_Action_Figure_Set_Star_Wars_Hasbro.asp}}</ref> while another figure had a darker brown color.<ref name="POTF2">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: The Power of the Force (1995 toy line)|pack=Jawa and Gonk Droid|link=potf2ctjawa.asp}}</ref> Another figure in [[2020]] also featured this power droid's photo but more resembled the Lars' droid.<ref name="VC Power Droid">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Vintage Collection|pack=#167: Power Droid|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/hasbro-star-wars/VC167-Power-Droid-The-Vintage-Collection-Hasbro.asp}}</ref>

''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]'' and ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' state that the power droid that C-3PO and R2-D2 found in the [[Sandcrawler/Legends|Jawa sandcrawler]] in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']] was an EG-6.<ref name="BtM" /><ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> However, this droid emits the "gonk" sound,<ref name="SW4" /> which is a feature of the [[GNK power droid/Legends|GNK power droid]].
